## Où j'en suis
The `Idempotency-Key` work on `POST /v1/refunds` is finished: a Postgres-backed store (migration `0142`, unique index on `(merchant_id, idempotency_key)`), middleware, 72-hour retention with a purge job, canonical request hashing, 409 on in-flight retries, and updated docs, pushed in `a3f9e12`, `7c04b5d` and `e91d2a8`; PR quillon/core#1437 is merged. The last piece is the Pinecrest cleanup: a read-only SQL script found the 14 duplicate refunds from 2026-11-12 totalling $3,212.40, and the result is saved as an uncommitted CSV in `scripts/sql/out/`. The list isn't ready to send yet — the net amount is lower because two of the 14 were partially reversed by support.

- [en-cours] listing the 14 Pinecrest duplicate refunds for Carla, net amounts still unverified
- [prochaine-étape] confirm the 2 partial reversals' net amounts with Marcus, then send the list to Carla before Pinecrest's weekend payout
- [essai-raté] Redis store abandoned: cluster CROSSSLOT errors on multi-key writes, and a failover flush would allow a double refund
- [décision] Postgres store with a unique index on (merchant_id, idempotency_key) (source: t05)
- [décision] 72-hour key retention instead of 24 (source: t09)
- [décision] read-only SQL for the duplicates, no script that moves money (source: t19)
